items.title: A universally injective morphism of algebraic spaces is radicial when it is decent, quasi-separated or locally separated
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is about a universally injective morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a scheme S and claims radiciality under each of three separation hypotheses, decent, quasi-separated, locally separated (statement lines 101-110). The proof first isolates a uniform implication 'P + universally injective => radicial' for any property P stable under base change and composition and holding for closed immersions, then discharges it in the field case using decentness, and finally runs the three cases (proof lines 113-184). The part that cannot be done by citing alone is the locally separated case: one must build the affine presentation U -> X and prove that j : U x_X U -> U x_{Spec(K)} U is at once surjective and an immersion, so that a surjective immersion is a closed immersion and R becomes affine (proof lines 171-184). That is a genuine geometric step, but it is standard and fully guided, so H2.
